evidence.photo_targets: Two broad rounded green reproductive bracts, bright yellow cyathia, glabrous green developing capsules, ordinary obovate leaves, repeated forking inflorescences. Do not draw misleading microscopic seam/horn/seed arrows.

science: FNA accepts Euphorbia roemeriana Scheele, section Tithymalus, a 15–30cm erect spring annual. Paired dichasial green bracts united ~half their length, distinguishing E. commutata; E. longicruris imbricate terminals; E. austrotexana narrow leaves; E. spathulata serrulate separate bracts plus warty capsules. Molecular study Peirson et al. 2014 documents Hays County, alongside Bandera, Comal, Edwards, Kerr and Travis. Formal BONAP/NAPA county nativity status unchanged.
